info.title: MindMora auth and notes API
info.description: Phase 1 auth and notes API. Online verified protected cookies, owner-scoped SQL/RLS, optimistic revisions and create-operation keys. Generated shared schemas; reviewed operation and security metadata. Production readiness and provider acceptance evidence are documented separately.

get.description: Server-only Node route. Bounds/method/Origin → online session verification → basic admission → strict input → scoped transaction → normalized response. All outcomes no-store. Lazy profile insert preserves existing profile. No queued save; workspace uses these APIs.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Exact APP_ORIGIN. GET may omit Origin but rejects a supplied foreign Origin.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: URL-encoded JSON object with exactly UTC millisecond updatedAt and UUID id. Omit on first page; ordering is updatedAt/id descending. Unknown/duplicate query keys rejected. Pages are not snapshots under edits.
